title: Process Capability Indices for Continuous Safety Monitoring

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain from SPC-based monitoring to early drift detection. Gap: simulating progressive drift via fine-tuning is the hardest part and the connection to real deployment drift is uncertain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Progressive fine-tuning on potentially harmful distributions requires advanced ML expertise and compute resources beyond what Colab Pro provides for iterative model modification.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three major components (progressive fine-tuning, SPC monitoring implementation, comparison with periodic benchmarks) make this a multi-phase project exceeding 30 hours.

novelty.reasoning: SPC applied to AI/ML monitoring is an emerging area with a 2025 survey (arxiv 2503.01858) covering AI in SPC and nonparametric control charts for neural network embedding drift. However, the specific application of process capability indices (Cp/Cpk) to continuous AI safety monitoring with progressive drift simulation has not been published. The general concept of SPC for ML model monitoring is partially explored but the safety-specific framing is newer.
